rejected_rule.statement: An appeal lies from a decision of the Commissioner under section 73 of the Estate Duty Ordinance to the District Judge, and such decision is not res judicata in respect of a matter to be decided under section 34 of the same ordinance.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "For the reasons I have given I Have come to the conclusion that the District Judge was right in holding that an appeal lies under section 34 from a decision of the Commissioner under section 73. With regard to the question of res judicata, ..."
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 34 of the Estate Duty Ordinance (Cap. 187)

meta.parties: The Attorney General v. Valliyamma Atchie
